subject: Business Models
title: Boo.com: Fashion Tech Disaster
description: A fast breakdown of Boo.com: Fashion Tech Disaster for builders.

hook.text: Boo.com spent $188 million in 18 months trying to sell fashion online. It launched in 18 countries at once.

buildup.text: Boo.com built a 3D virtual shopping experience with a talking avatar. On 1999 dial-up internet, it barely loaded.

discovery.text: The site took 30+ seconds to load. 56K modems couldn't handle the advanced graphics. Most visitors left immediately.

twist.text: Boo.com launched in 18 countries before testing one. Different currencies, sizes, and return policies multiplied costs.

climax.text: Boo.com built for the internet of 2010 on the infrastructure of 1999. Vision without timing is just expensive dreaming.

punchline.text: $188M, 18 countries, 30-second loads. Too much vision, too little bandwidth.

quiz.question: What was Boo.com's fatal flaw?
options: Building rich web experiences that 1999 internet couldn't support
